lines.zh: 我不在地上走，我贴着墙爬
lines.en: I do not walk on the ground; I crawl on walls.

lines.zh: 四只小手一合一分，我就挪过去了
lines.en: Four small hands clasp and release, and I am across.

lines.zh: 我沿着天花板边缘慢慢移
lines.en: I edge along the ceiling line.

lines.zh: 倒挂着走，对我来说一样
lines.en: Walking upside down is the same to me.

lines.zh: 我换了一条缝，你还在看原来的地方
lines.en: I changed crevices while you still watched the old one.

lines.zh: 十指扣着砖缝，一点声音都没有
lines.en: My fingers grip the brick gaps without a sound.

lines.zh: 我绕着梁走，避开光线
lines.en: I move along the beam, avoiding the light.

lines.zh: 我爬到竖井边上，往下一看
lines.en: I reach the shaft's lip and peer down.

lines.zh: 一米二的身体，藏起来很容易
lines.en: One block of me is easy to hide.

lines.zh: 我从这面墙挪到那面墙
lines.en: I shift from this wall to that one.

lines.zh: 我停下，是因为你在看
lines.en: I stop because you are looking.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子往上走
lines.en: I climb up along my own shadow.

lines.zh: 我贴在墙上，像一块污渍
lines.en: I cling to the wall like a stain.

lines.zh: 只有头探出来，其余都在拐角后
lines.en: Only my head shows; the rest is around the corner.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很大，眨得很少
lines.en: My eyes are large and seldom blink.

lines.zh: 我数你在这个房间里走了几步
lines.en: I count your steps in this room.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你也找不到我
lines.en: I stay still, and you cannot find me.

lines.zh: 梁上有一层灰，我压出印子
lines.en: There is dust on the beam; I leave prints.

lines.zh: 这具身体只够撑一会儿
lines.en: This body lasts only so long.

lines.zh: 我离你不远，但不在你的视线里
lines.en: I am close, but not in your sight.

lines.zh: 我听着你的呼吸，很稳
lines.en: I listen to your breathing; it is steady.

lines.zh: 墙角那处最暗，我在那
lines.en: The darkest corner is mine.

lines.zh: 我把头歪向一边，学你的样子
lines.en: I tilt my head to one side, copying you.

lines.zh: 我的手指太长，不像人
lines.en: My fingers are too long to be human.

lines.zh: 屋里有风，我的头发动了
lines.en: There is a draft; my hair stirs.

lines.zh: 我躲在天花板的暗里
lines.en: I hide in the dark of the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶的角落看你
lines.en: I watch you from the corner above your head.

lines.zh: 你抬头了，我就缩回去
lines.en: You look up, and I pull back.

lines.zh: 我在你背后的墙上
lines.en: I am on the wall behind you.

lines.zh: 我们的眼睛对上了
lines.en: Our eyes have met.

lines.zh: 你想再看第二眼，我已经不在了
lines.en: Look a second time and I am gone.

lines.zh: 我挂在门框上方，你正好走进来
lines.en: I hang above the doorframe as you walk in.

lines.zh: 我的头比身体大，这样看得清
lines.en: My head is bigger than my body, the better to see.

lines.zh: 你退开，我没有追
lines.en: You back away; I do not follow.

lines.zh: 我就露半张脸，够你记住
lines.en: Half my face is enough for you to remember.

lines.zh: 你点了火把，我就往暗处挪
lines.en: You light a torch; I shift into the dark.

lines.zh: 我在竖井顶上探出头
lines.en: I poke my head over the shaft's rim.

lines.zh: 你在下面，我在上面
lines.en: You are below; I am above.

lines.zh: 你数过这个房间有几个角落吗
lines.en: Have you counted the corners of this room?

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，牙齿很小很密
lines.en: I smile, teeth small and close-set.

lines.zh: 我能一直看着，看到你习惯
lines.en: I can watch until you grow used to it.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我的位置就空
lines.en: Turn around and my spot is empty.

lines.zh: 墙上的影子多了一块
lines.en: There is one extra shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了你就跑
lines.en: I do not call out; a call would make you run.

lines.zh: 我挂在那里很久了
lines.en: I have hung there a long while.

lines.zh: 你的灯照不到那个角度
lines.en: Your light does not reach that angle.

lines.zh: 我掉下半格，又抓住墙
lines.en: I drop half a block, then catch the wall.

lines.zh: 这点血，一下就没了
lines.en: That sliver of life is nearly gone.

lines.zh: 我缩进缝隙，只留一只手
lines.en: I squeeze into the gap, one hand showing.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，很细
lines.en: I make a thin little sound.

lines.zh: 我爬到更高的地方
lines.en: I climb higher.

lines.zh: 我不敢再靠近了
lines.en: I dare not come closer.

lines.zh: 我的手指抓不住墙了
lines.en: My fingers can no longer grip the wall.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你，像不明白
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, uncomprehending.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往后退，一直看着你
lines.en: I inch backward, watching you all the way.

lines.zh: 你要再看我，得抬头
lines.en: To see me again, you will have to look up.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西，我够得到
lines.en: What you set down, I can reach.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只看你来不来拿
lines.en: I do not eat; I only watch whether you come for it.

lines.zh: 我从上面伸手，够了一下
lines.en: I reach down from above, just once.

lines.zh: 你一低头，我就贴近了
lines.en: When you look down, I come closer.

lines.zh: 我把它拨到地上，引你过来
lines.en: I flick it to the floor to draw you over.

lines.zh: 这东西亮，我不喜欢亮
lines.en: It is bright, and I dislike bright.

lines.zh: 我倒挂在上面，盯着那点东西。
lines.en: I hang upside down, eyeing that little thing.

lines.zh: 你伸手的时候，手背最凉
lines.en: Your hand is coldest at the back when you reach.

lines.zh: 我没拿，我只是碰了碰
lines.en: I did not take it; I only touched it.

lines.zh: 你再放一次，我还会来
lines.en: Set it down again, and I will come again.

lines.zh: 你撞到墙上，我在上面看着
lines.en: You hit the wall; I watch from above.

lines.zh: 我从你肩头擦过，很轻
lines.en: I brush past your shoulder, barely.

lines.zh: 你被我一碰，整个人僵住
lines.en: One touch from me and you go rigid.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我弹回墙上
lines.en: We collide and I spring back to the wall.

lines.zh: 我太轻，撞不动你
lines.en: I am too light to move you.

lines.zh: 这一下我掉下来半格
lines.en: That knocked me half a block down.

lines.zh: 我抓着你的衣服，很快松开
lines.en: I grab your clothes and let go quickly.

lines.zh: 我们接触的位置冷了一小块
lines.en: The spot we touched turns cold.

lines.zh: 你没看清是什么撞的
lines.en: You did not see what hit you.

lines.zh: 我退到梁上，重新趴好
lines.en: I retreat to the beam and settle again.

lines.zh: 我们互相挂着，头对着头
lines.en: We hang facing each other, head to head.

lines.zh: 两只小的，藏在同一个角落
lines.en: Two small things hiding in one corner.

lines.zh: 我们不落地，只在上面相遇
lines.en: We never touch the floor; we meet aloft.

lines.zh: 你的手扣这边，我的扣那边
lines.en: You grip this side, I grip that.

lines.zh: 我们有同样的长手指
lines.en: We share the same long fingers.

lines.zh: 一起看下面那个人，很有意思
lines.en: Watching the one below together is amusing.

lines.zh: 我们从不一起动
lines.en: We never move at the same time.

lines.zh: 一个守天花板，一个守竖井
lines.en: One keeps the ceiling, one the shaft.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在墙上叠成一个
lines.en: Our shadows merge into one on the wall.

lines.zh: 这屋子太小，装两个就挤了
lines.en: This room is small; two of us crowd it.

lines.zh: 两根手指就能把我夹起来。
lines.en: Two fingers could pinch me up.

lines.zh: 东西比我的手还大
lines.en: It is bigger than my hand.

lines.zh: 我把它挂在高处的钉子上
lines.en: I hang it on a high nail.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，倒挂着看你
lines.en: I hold it and look at you from upside down.

lines.zh: 一滑，它掉了下去
lines.en: It slips and falls.

lines.zh: 我不用整只手，只用指尖
lines.en: Not my whole hand, only my fingertips.

lines.zh: 我把它藏进梁缝里
lines.en: I hide it in a gap in the beam.

lines.zh: 拿着东西我就爬不快
lines.en: Carrying it slows my climbing.

lines.zh: 我只是想看你够不够得着
lines.en: I only want to see whether you can reach it.

lines.zh: 我把它放到最高的角落
lines.en: I put it in the highest corner.

lines.zh: 你在这个房间待太久了
lines.en: You have stayed in this room too long.

lines.zh: 我从上面选好了角度
lines.en: I have chosen my angle from above.

lines.zh: 你抬头的那一瞬，我换了位置
lines.en: When you look up, I have moved.

lines.zh: 这间屋子只有一个出口
lines.en: This room has only one exit.

lines.zh: 我在你的视线死角里
lines.en: I am in your blind spot.

lines.zh: 我不需要靠近，我只要一直看着
lines.en: I need not approach; I only need to keep watching.

lines.zh: 竖井边缘，正好能探出头
lines.en: The shaft rim is perfect for peeking over.

lines.zh: 你点着火把，却照不到我
lines.en: You lit a torch, yet it does not reach me.

lines.zh: 我等你把灯放下
lines.en: I am waiting for you to set the lamp down.

lines.zh: 你在这下面，我在上面，位置刚好
lines.en: You below, me above: just right.

lines.zh: 我选了那个你最不会看的角落
lines.en: I chose the corner you would least look at.

lines.zh: 你没有发现我，这很好
lines.en: You have not found me; good.

lines.zh: 我挪到了你正上方
lines.en: I have moved directly above you.

lines.zh: 你听见声音了吗，那是我碰了梁
lines.en: Did you hear that? I touched the beam.

lines.zh: 我一直在，只是你没抬头
lines.en: I was always there; you simply did not look up.

lines.zh: 这次我不躲了
lines.en: This time I will not hide.

lines.zh: 我挂在梁上，一直没动
lines.en: I hang from the beam, never moving.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我就在那边的墙上
lines.en: Wherever you go, I am on that wall.

lines.zh: 我在等你自己抬头
lines.en: I am waiting for you to look up on your own.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很轻，你听不见
lines.en: My breathing is faint; you cannot hear it.

lines.zh: 我换了三次位置，你没发现
lines.en: I moved three times; you never noticed.

lines.zh: 这个角度，你转身也看不到
lines.en: From this angle, even turning will not show me.

lines.zh: 你越紧张，我越不动
lines.en: The more tense you get, the stiller I become.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，所以我很谨慎
lines.en: I have only a sliver of life, so I am cautious.

lines.zh: 我不会下来，我在上面更安全
lines.en: I will not come down; I am safer above.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我就退到梁后
lines.en: Look up, and I slide behind the beam.

lines.zh: 你放下火把，暗处就归我了
lines.en: Set the torch down, and the dark is mine.

lines.zh: 我一直数着你的脚步
lines.en: I keep counting your steps.

lines.zh: 这一处阴影刚好够我藏
lines.en: This shadow is just enough to hide me.

lines.zh: 我等你把背转过去
lines.en: I wait for you to turn your back.

lines.zh: 我从竖井爬上来一点
lines.en: I climb a little higher up the shaft.

lines.zh: 我的头一直对着你
lines.en: My head stays pointed at you.

lines.zh: 你开始怀疑了，我能看出来
lines.en: You are starting to doubt; I can tell.

lines.zh: 再近一点，你就听得见我了
lines.en: One step closer and you will hear me.

lines.zh: 你找不到我，但你知道我在
lines.en: You cannot find me, but you know I am here.

lines.zh: 时间不多了，我得快点
lines.en: Time is short; I must hurry.

lines.zh: 我伸手碰了一下你的头发
lines.en: I reach out and touch your hair.

lines.zh: 我从上面扑下来，又吊回梁上
lines.en: I drop at you, then swing back to the beam.

lines.zh: 这一抓很轻，连皮都没破
lines.en: This scratch is light; it does not even break skin.

lines.zh: 我根本没有力气打你
lines.en: I have no strength to hurt you.

lines.zh: 我只是想看看你的反应
lines.en: I only wanted to see your reaction.

lines.zh: 我不咬，我只是靠得很近
lines.en: I do not bite; I only come very close.

lines.zh: 我的头从你肩后探出来
lines.en: My head appears behind your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你喊了一声，我立刻躲了
lines.en: You shout, and I hide at once.

lines.zh: 碰一下就跑，这是我的方式
lines.en: Touch and flee; that is my way.

lines.zh: 我挂在你上方的角落等你抬头
lines.en: I hang in the corner above you, waiting.

lines.zh: 我们离得太近，我能数你的睫毛
lines.en: So close I could count your lashes.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候没有声音
lines.en: My laugh makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我在你耳边停了一瞬
lines.en: I pause a moment at your ear.

lines.zh: 你转身，我吊在天花板上
lines.en: You turn; I am hanging from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我只是想看你怕不怕
lines.en: I only wanted to see if you are afraid.

lines.zh: 这点力气，推不动你
lines.en: That much force will not move you.

lines.zh: 墙角先多了一个影子
lines.en: A shadow appears in the corner first.

lines.zh: 我从竖井边缘探出头
lines.en: I poke my head over the shaft's rim.

lines.zh: 天花板上有响动，很轻
lines.en: A faint stirring on the ceiling.

lines.zh: 这地方有足够多的角落
lines.en: There are enough corners here.

lines.zh: 我挂在门框上方，等有人进来
lines.en: I hang above the doorframe, waiting for someone.

lines.zh: 一米二的身体，藏起来不难
lines.en: One block of body is not hard to hide.

lines.zh: 我先看了三个位置才选这里
lines.en: I checked three spots before choosing this one.

lines.zh: 我的手指先扣住砖缝
lines.en: My fingers grip the brick gap first.

lines.zh: 你听见头顶有声音吗
lines.en: Did you hear something overhead?

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，但我不需要多
lines.en: I have only a sliver of life, and I need no more.

lines.zh: 我从上面看着下面
lines.en: I watch from above.

lines.zh: 这间屋子有梁，正好
lines.en: This room has a beam; perfect.

lines.zh: 我贴在暗处，等眼睛适应
lines.en: I cling in the dark, waiting for eyes to adjust.

lines.zh: 我不是从门进来的
lines.en: I did not come through the door.

lines.zh: 拐角后面，有我的一半身体
lines.en: Half of me is behind the corner.

lines.zh: 我一直挂在梁下，直到你抬头。
lines.en: I have hung beneath the beam until you looked up.

lines.zh: 屋里的光不够，我很满意
lines.en: There is not enough light here; I am pleased.

lines.zh: 我数清了这一层有几个房间
lines.en: I have counted the rooms on this floor.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声比你轻
lines.en: My breathing is quieter than yours.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我已经不在了
lines.en: By the time you look up, I am gone.

lines.zh: 火光一亮，我尖叫着往暗处爬
lines.en: The flame flares; I shriek and crawl for the dark.

lines.zh: 我从梁上掉下来，摔在地上
lines.en: I fall from the beam and hit the floor.

lines.zh: 水灌进我鼻子里，我胡乱抓
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I claw wildly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从墙上掀下来
lines.en: The blast peels me off the wall.

lines.zh: 一根木箭钉穿了我挂在墙上的手。
lines.en: An arrow pins the hand I was hanging by.

lines.zh: 那股光找到我了，我躲不开
lines.en: That light found me; I cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我本来就不吃东西
lines.en: I never ate anything anyway.

lines.zh: 雷光把整间屋子照亮，我缩成一团
lines.en: The flash lights the whole room; I curl up tight.

lines.zh: 墙没了，我抓不到东西
lines.en: No wall left to grip.
